title: Compartment door observed open after an unlock pulse
description: Published on locker/{locker_uuid}/event once the client has observed the physical door state following an open_compartment pulse (ADR-0031). The command response only acknowledges that the pulse was sent; this message reports whether the door actually opened. `outcome: opened` means the door was closed before the pulse and opened within the detection window, with `detection_ms` measuring pulse to observation. `outcome: already_open` means the door was already open before the pulse, so no window was opened and no `detection_ms` is reported.

detection_ms.description: Milliseconds from the unlock pulse to the door being observed open. Absent for already_open.
